items.title: A New Defense Stock Is Born: Lyntris IPO Set For Wednesday
items.summary: The defense contractor Lyntris sold 17 million shares in its IPO. The stock began trading on Wednesday at 11% below its list price of $17.50 a share, according to MarketSurge.

items.title: Lockheed Wins Slew Of Contracts. Air Force Doles Out $920 Mil Award.
items.summary: The Department of Defense awarded Lockheed Martin multiple contracts worth over $152 million. The Air Force taps 24 companies for a $920 million award.

items.title: Boeing-Lockheed’s ULA triples bond sale to $1.5 billion - report
items.summary: Investing.com -- United Launch Alliance has completed a $1.5 billion private bond offering, three times larger than the company's initial target of $500 million, according to a Bloomberg report Tuesday.

items.title: RTX, Lockheed, and 7 More Stocks to Consider as Missile Production Rockets Higher
items.summary: Coming into Tuesday trading, shares of 10 major defense contractors Barron’s looked at—including  Lockheed Martin Northrop Grumman Huntington-Ingalls Industries  and others—were down an average of 17% since fighting started in Iran.  Only  RTX  and  General Dynamics  were up.  U.S. defense spending is at a record high, European defense spending is growing, and the Iran war is teaching the American military how to build more autonomous weapons systems and smart munitions.

items.title: Is Northrop Grumman Expanding Its Presence in Military Training?
items.summary: NOC is expanding its military training footprint with LVC, immersive and electromagnetic simulation tools for complex missions.

items.title: RTX Stock Gets a Radar Lock on a $23B Navy Win
items.summary: RTX Corporation secured a $22.9 billion Navy Tomahawk contract and topped Q2 2026 earnings estimates, prompting raised full-year guidance and continued dividend growth.
